widgets_values: An image of an ancient ape-man covered with thick brown hair all over his body, still retaining typical ape-like features on his face (high brow bones, wide and flat nose, thick lips), with a burly and strong build. Dressed in primitive tribal style clothing: a dress sewn with brown animal skin (fringed with tassels), paired with a necklace made of colorful feathers and animal teeth, as well as arm bands/leg ornaments wrapped in animal skin. Practicing yoga in the room creates a visual contrast where "wild and primitive" and "modern and contemporary" collide.
